title: reservation-migration-operator-onboarding-and-release-calendar
creator: Aisha Raman
description:
Summary: Coordinate a multi-staged launch that migrates early EU customers from flex reservations to the new compact reservation SKU (g11x-compact family). This ticket ties together operator onboarding (Support/SE/Sales), legal/compliance sign-offs for contract wording in EU markets, release notes sequencing, and a detailed calendar for customer-facing comms.

Progress updates: 
- 2025-02-12: Kickoff completed with ENG (runtime/infra), Legal, Sales Ops, Support triage. Agreed scope: migration tooling + console UI flag + billing backfill window.
- 2025-02-15: Draft release notes created (docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/784). QA checklist added to NOTES.
- 2025-02-18: Legal provided redlines for reservation contract changes; need final sign-off for EU-specific data residency clause.
- 2025-02-21: Console feature branch deployed to staging; feature flag "eu_reservations_v2" enabled for internal test orgs.
- 2025-02-25: Sales Enablement deck (v0.3) circulated for feedback.
- 2025-02-28: Pilot cohort (5 customers) identified and invited; migration windows proposed March 10–14.

Decisions / trade-offs: 
- We will phase migration to reduce blast radius: pilot -> limited beta (50 orgs) -> GA. This reduces initial support load but extends overall timeline.
- Billing backfill will be run as a single sweep per billing cycle to avoid duplicated invoices; trade-off is slightly delayed cost reporting for converted customers.
- Console rollout will be gated by both Legal sign-off and runtime autoscaling stress test passing (see dependencies ENG-20401).

Outstanding blockers: 
- Legal final sign-off on EU contract language (owner: Priya Kapoor, Legal).
- Runtime stress tests for compact reservations under burst traffic (owner: Marco Díaz, Eng).
- Billing edge-case for partial-month converts (owner: Finance Ops).

Stakeholders and cadence: 
- Product (owner): Liam Chen
- ENG owners: Marco Díaz (runtime), Elena Park (billing)
- Sales Enablement: Jorge Morales
- Legal: Priya Kapoor
- Support Lead: Nina Osei
- Weekly sync: Tuesdays 09:30 CET (recurring, invite: dedicated-gTM@s.redwood)
acceptance_criteria: 1) Console UI flag and migration wizard present in staging and passes accessibility checks; 2) Pilot cohort migrates with no critical incidents and average token latency variance <10% compared to pre-migration; 3) Legal sign-off documented and attached; 4) Release notes approved and scheduled; 5) Sales/Support enablement artifacts published and linked.
tasks: Finalize legal redlines and attach signed doc
Complete staging stress tests and upload runbook
Publish release notes and changelog entry
Create Sales Enablement one-pager and migration FAQ
Schedule pilot migration windows and confirm with customers
Prepare rollback plan and capacity fallback routing rules
Sync billing runbook with Finance Ops for backfill
notes:
Key links: Confluence spec: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/DED/Compact+Reservations+Migration, Docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/784, Billing RFC: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/billing-rfc. Suggested rollback trigger: >5% of pilot orgs reporting failed completions OR any SLO breach >2x for 15m.
Next steps: chase Legal for final sign-off (target 2025-03-03), complete EN G stress test (target 2025-03-04), confirm pilot confirmations by 2025-03-05.
